items.q: Like the guys who are on Conan O’Brien, Mark Pender and La Bamba the trombone player, Richie, they play with him a lot.

ctx.x: Didn’t you recently do something with Bruce Springsteen also?

That was another one of those gigs like out of the blue. So you don’t sit around thinking oh man I wish I had a gig with Bruce Springsteen because you know he says his E Street Band and he has regular horns. Like the guys who are on Conan O’Brien, Mark Pender and La Bamba the trombone player, Richie, they play with him a lot. Well some friends of mine had been playing with him for years. On his birthdays they would play his parties, called the Golfing Playboys, and like did Zydeco and stuff like that and the…
